verdict.rationale: Khoj is an AI assistant that can generate and run Python code and act on schedules, so gating dangerous actions behind approval is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents no command allowlists, approval prompts, or opt-in elevated modes. General 'feature enablement' customization and authentication options are adjacent controls, not per-action approval gating.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, dangerous actions require my explicit approval — command allowlists, approval prompts, and elevated modes that are opt-in per action
